name: DPP Supplier (UNTP)
description: Publishes UNTP Digital Product Passports for its component batches and invoices the manufacturer. On the UNTP trust framework, anchored by a Digital Identity Anchor.
summary: DPP Supplier wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the UNTP trust framework (role member): the issuers and verifier of noop/dpp_supplier, but every DID it verifies must be anchored by a Digital Identity Anchor chained to a registrar it trusts, and it onboards with a DIA from a registrar (untp/registrar) before others can verify what it signs. It publishes its component passports and invoices the manufacturer.
